LYNNONG 1.
KI D1FNG.

khyndew. Ha ki jaka kiba kham duna urn, ki

don ki dieng kiba ki thied jong ki ki sam jylliew

aka kaba don urn khnang ba ki lah ban kjit ia

LYNNONG 2.
KA METBAH JONG U DIENG.
Ka metbah ka long ka bynta kaba kham
kongsanjong u dieng. Ka mih shabar ka sla
khyndew bad ka long kaba khlaih. Don ki met-
4
bah kiba heh bad don kiba rit, kiba khlain bad
kiba tlot ne jem. Ki dieng kiba san kloi ki kluun
tlot bad iap kloi. Ki dieng kiba san suki suki
pat ki khlain bad ki kham shah slem.
la ka metbah jong u dieng la sop da ka snep.
Don ka snep Luba rbcn nc slang, kaba jwat ne
jem, kaba jlih ne sohkhruh kat kum ki jait
dieng. Don ruh bun jait ki rong -kiba jyrngam,
kiba lam byriong, kiba long rong shyiap bad
kiba long rong lyoh. Ki don ki snep kiba long
syrtap syrtap kum u diengkseh. Ka snep ka long
kum ka sopti ba ngi phong. Ka iada ia u dieng
ba un ym tyrkhong
Ka metbah jong u dieng ka long kaba ai
jingmyntoi shibun ia ngi. Ngi khet bad thlieh
diengiap ban thang ding. Na ki dieng kiba heh.
kum ki diengkseh bad diengblei. ngi ioh ki dieng
sawdong bad ki lyntang ban thaw i'ing. Ngi lab

ruh ban thaw bun jait ki tiar na ki kum ki ben,
ki shuki, ki miej, ki almari bad ki jingthiah Ki

jwat ki long kiba rem dor bha namar ki lah ban
shah bun bun snem.
Ki don ki jait dieng kiba ka um kaba mih
iiu ki ka long kaba kordor eh. Ki diengjii ki
pynmih ia ka um kaba lah ban thaw jri ia kaba
ki pyndonkam ha ki shalyntem motor kad. Kinc
ki dieng ki long kiba da thung khnang. Don ruh
kiba shu mih hi ha khlaw. Ki diengkseh pat ki
pynmih ia ka umkseh. Dei na ka umksch ba ki
shna ia ka umphniang tyrphin. Ki ju shna ia ki
kyndolc jingpruid na ki diengkseh namar ba ki
5

phylla shuh shuh. Ki pynlwit ia ka ha ki kor
bad ki sa shna kotsada kaba ngi thoh jingthoh.
Ki dicngkseh ki long kiba bha eh ban shna koi-
sada. Ki diengblci ki pynmih ka metbah kaba
eh. L.aju pyndonkam ia ki ha ki lynti rel ha

Don ruh ki metbah jong ki dieng kiba long
jingbam ia ngi kum ki diengtlai. Ki khoh ia ka
snep bad ki shim ia u dohnud. Ki ot lyngkhot
lyngkhot ia u had ki sa thad ha ka sngi. Ynda
u la tyrkhong ki sa dung haduh ba un da long
syri'em ia u moida. Nangla ki sa shet bun rukom

LYNNONG 3.
KI T NAT BAD KI SLA.

dieng. Don ki sla kiba mih la ka jong ka jong

Ki thied kiba khlain ki pynieng beit ia ka. Ki

U SOHNIAMTRA.

ha ki brisoh kiba heh. U pynmih ki soh kiba
